description: The file defines the application configuration for an Angular frontend, specifying providers such as routing, HTTP client, zone change detection, and client hydration with event replay.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Configures Angular's zone change detection with event coalescing enabled.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Provides the application routes for navigation.

methods.name: provideHttpClient
methods.description: Provides the HTTP client service for making HTTP requests.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables client-side hydration with event replay functionality.

methods.name: withEventReplay
methods.description: Specifies the event replay strategy during hydration.
